title: 云依助手 0.13.5
releaseNotes: Unifies the remaining 17 tool workspaces with slate-blue headings, warm neutral panels and distinct input/output surfaces inspired by the system tools. Refreshes communication logs with consistent TX, RX, status and error colors while retaining diff, regex and protocol highlights. Improves solid action contrast across all three themes. Preserves layout, fonts, scrolling, sidebar, pet appearance, communication and confirmation behavior. All 20 tools and the packaged pink Yiyi character are retained.
